This live region announces a durable archive upload/import job's current file, server job status and progress percentage. It is asynchronous task progress, not the calculated result of a form control. The existing status role and Progress child preserve the application log accessibility contract; floating-window/import fixtures retain that behavior.

AgentLogsDeleteButton is the presentation of the existing useDeletionJobController in this file. That hook alone owns preview and job queries, captured time bounds, stable job_id for ambiguous retries, create/stop mutations and terminal onFinished deduplication. The component composes one deletion modal with form, server job details, progress and action slots; it does not execute the deletion loop or own another resource. Exact create/stop grants guard mutation entry. log-deletion tests cover stable-id retry, server-observed running jobs, stop, terminal refresh and durable Agent Flow deletion without the legacy delete endpoint. Declaration length does not identify a competing owner. Source reassessed 2026-11-03; execution remains centralized QA.
